purpose: Rich, interactive content anchored to a trigger, such as a share panel, a small form or details on demand.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the popover; also its accessible name

props.name: trigger
props.description: A Button or IconButton that opens it

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side; flips when there is no room. Defaults to bottom

whenToUse: For a short task or extra detail that should stay next to its trigger
whenNotToUse: For a list of actions — use Menu
For a long or blocking task — use Modal or Drawer
For a hint of a few words — use Tooltip
antiPatterns: Putting a whole form with many fields in a popover

anatomy: The shared elevation-2 popover with a heading and body
sizes: Width between three quarters of `size-modal-sm` and `size-modal-sm`; padding `space-component-padding-md`
motion: Enters with `motion-easing-enter`, exits with `motion-easing-exit`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: A dialog named by its title; focus moves into it
Escape or a click outside closes it and focus returns to the trigger
